# Design by Baxit

> Brand design and growth marketing studio. Builds brand systems, websites and
> growth marketing that cut through the noise — so the right customers find,
> trust and choose the business. Tagline: "less noise more growth."

Founded and led by Abdul Basit (Founder & Lead Designer).

## Services

- Brand identity — logo, visual system, guidelines.
- Websites — design and build.
- Growth marketing — positioning, content and acquisition.
- Optimisation — improving an existing brand, site or funnel.

## Pages

- [Home](https://new-ck7.pages.dev/): overview of services and approach.
- [About](https://new-ck7.pages.dev/about.html): founder background and studio story.
- [Free Consultation](https://new-ck7.pages.dev/consultation.html): book a free 30-minute
  consultation reviewing where a brand currently stands; includes frequently
  asked questions about the process.
- [Contact](https://new-ck7.pages.dev/contact.html): general enquiries.

## Contact

- Email: designbybaxit@gmail.com
- Response time: within one working day.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The free consultation is genuinely free — no card required, no obligation to
  proceed afterwards.
- Design by Baxit takes on a limited number of projects at a time, so typical
  start time after a successful consultation is one to two weeks.
